description: Source code for sensor and device management in Zephyr RTOS, including sensor data fetching, motion detection, and mesh network suspend/resume handling.

methods.name: periphs_init
methods.description: Initializes peripherals by binding sensors and configuring accelerometer trigger.

methods.name: get_hdc1010_val
methods.description: Fetches temperature and humidity data from HDC1010 sensor.

methods.name: get_mma8652_val
methods.description: Fetches accelerometer data from MMA8652 sensor.

methods.name: get_apds9960_val
methods.description: Fetches light and proximity data from APDS9960 sensor.

methods.name: motion_timeout
methods.description: Handles power saving by suspending mesh network after timeout.

methods.name: motion_handler
methods.description: Handles motion detection events to resume mesh network.

methods.name: configure_accel
methods.description: Configures accelerometer trigger for motion detection.
